title: Pregnancy can be a meaningful journey that looks different for everyone.
description:
Nau mai, haere mai! Every pregnancy is unique, and you deserve tailored support for you and your whānau throughout your pregnancy.

Built specifically for Aotearoa New Zealand, our app provides helpful guidance and tools grounded in research on placental growth and its potential complications. This includes dedicated support for small gestational age (SGA) and fetal growth restriction (FGR) pathways, helping you stay informed and track the development of pēpi.

While we hope to help mums and their whānau have a safe and healthy pregnancy, please do not treat the information presented on this web app as official medical advice or diagnosis. The app is designed to complement the care you and your pēpi receive from your lead maternity carer (LMC), who is your first port of call for any health concerns.

items.title: What is happening in pregnancy?
items.description: Information on how your body changes to support your pēpi's (baby) growth during pregnancy, and how your midwife/doctor will track the health of you and your pēpi.

items.title: What does my ultrasound scan mean?
items.description: Ultrasound scans let doctors check on the health of your pēpi (and its placenta). Use our interactive tool to better understand what ultrasound measures, how it can tell us about pēpi's health, and what your scan may mean.

items.title: How to navigate pregnancy complications?
items.description: What you need to know about why complications occur, how they are detected, and what this may mean for your pregnancy journey and beyond.

items.title: What does pregnancy care look like in Aotearoa NZ?
items.description: Information on care pathways you can choose in NZ for your pregnancy, how to find a midwife, and how care may change if there are any concerns about the pregnancy.

items.title: What pregnancy / pēpi (baby) support services are available?
items.description: The pregnancy experience is different for everyone. Here, you can find information about support services available to you and your whānau (family) to help you navigate your journey, whatever it may look like.

items.title: About us
items.description: Learn more about the team behind this app and how we are working to support you and your whānau (family).
